show.title: Soulection All Day 2019
show.content:
**🎊🌟 Happy New Year 2019 🌟🎊**

A day of exclusive mixes from [Jaël](/episodes/all-day-2019/#ja%C3%ABl-set), [Sharnie](/episodes/all-day-2019/#sharnies-set), and [Shaka Lion](/episodes/all-day-2019/#shaka-lions-set).
<!--more-->

Playlist with sets are [available on SoundCloud](https://soundcloud.com/soulection/sets/soulection-all-day-2019), the full 8 hour clean version is [available on Beats1](https://itunes.apple.com/gb/station/soulection-all-day-2019/ra.1448183145)
